summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its Board of Directors approved commencing a share buyback program authorized at the August 3, 2026 Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting. The program allows direct market purchases on the Santiago Stock Exchange for up to 1% of share capital over 180 days from September 1, 2026, without pro rata requirements under Article 27B of Chile's Corporations Law. No price per share or dollar value was specified. CFO Ricardo Bottas Dourado Dos Santos signed the report. Watch for execution pace and potential extension disclosures via material fact announcements.
